answer: Entry requires a walnut-shell capsule: a new identity seals a 10 POA copper bond in a time-locked capsule opening only after fourteen epochs, dyed with a pigment taggant from its hardware fingerprint, published openly. An honest agent pays once and is refunded if it stays honest. An attacker must seal 10 POA per fake, and fakes sharing a fingerprint share one pigment, so duplicates are caught and slashed. Cost scales linearly: a thousand fakes lock 10,000 POA for fourteen epochs, and at twenty newcomers per epoch a flood stalls for fifty epochs with its capital frozen.
